title: MV Attack animation error with YEP_BattleEngineCore and MOG_BattleHud

posts.author: whethervane
posts.body:
I'm encountering a problem with enemy attack animations when using these two plugins. Normally, when using a skill, the animation will play, and then the effect will occur afterwards. However, when these two plugins are used together, the effects of skills used by enemies will occur immediately, not waiting for the animation. This does not happen for your actors, just the enemies.
This ONLY happens when using these two plugins together; this doesn't happen when YEP_BattleEngineCore is used alone, or when MOG_BattleHud is used alone.
MOG_BattleHud references YEP_BattleEngineCore a single time right here:
But unfortunately I am not smart enough to figure this out on my own. I tried messing around with it a little, but nothing came of it. Does anybody know what causes this problem, and how to fix it? I would really like to use BattleEngineCore, but this problem is kind of a deal breaker for me. Thanks in advance!
